delivery-ledger-for-deployment-owners.text: As an integrator, I need the PR's task stamps to point to source and receipts rather than imply that a green build proves attachment behavior.

work-items.text: Task stamps report implementation and integration work completed before the final gate. The exact-head gate, independent audit, pushed-head CI closure of MISSING-CI-JOB, ticket acceptance, epic merge and release are separate receipts; no task stamp can turn an unexecuted CI job into a pass.
